situation: I sit down at my desk in the morning
behavior: I open whatever feels interesting and figure out what to do as I go

situation: I notice an email needs a reply that will take ten minutes
behavior: I tell myself I'll get to it and the inbox slowly piles up

situation: I finish using a tool or piece of equipment
behavior: I leave it on the counter and grab the next thing

situation: I am given a deadline two weeks out
behavior: I figure I have plenty of time and start it the night before

situation: I am partway through a task and feel like quitting
behavior: I switch to something else and tell myself I'll come back to it

situation: I commit verbally to do something for someone
behavior: I trust I'll remember and sometimes I don't

situation: I notice the kitchen counter is cluttered
behavior: I leave it for later and walk past it

situation: I am proofreading something I wrote
behavior: I skim it once and call it done

situation: I plan a trip a few weeks ahead
behavior: I throw clothes in a bag the morning of and hope I have what I need

situation: I see I am running slightly behind schedule
behavior: I shrug and figure it'll work out
